01 / BRAND STORY & CREATIVE VISION

Jewelry designed
to spark joy.

Gummy Gem Studio is an independently developed jewelry brand built around colorful self-expression, playful design, and joyful personal style.

The brand world combines candy-inspired color, Austrian crystal jewelry, thoughtful product design, and optimistic digital merchandising.

Founder / Jewelry Designer / Logo Designer /
Creative Director / Product Photographer & Videographer

02 / ORIGINAL LOGO DESIGN

A playful identity, designed from scratch.

I designed the Gummy Gem Studio logo from scratch, selecting and customizing soft, rounded lettering to reflect the candy-inspired name and colorful gemstone collection.

THE DESIGN DECISION

Rounded forms communicate approachability and playfulness. The bold, customized lettering supports recognition, while the sparkle detail reinforces the brand's jewelry identity.

TYPOGRAPHY

Logo: Customized rounded lettering informed by Averta Soft, Sofia Pro Soft, and Nunito ExtraBold.

Headlines: Poppins ExtraBold — modern, bold, clean, and confident.
